messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: AL7075-T6 | OD: 180.0mm | ID: 54.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 180.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 54.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 120.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 6.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"120.0",
        f"180.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"125.0",
        f"54.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 9.23
    for i in range(1, 13):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"168.0",
            f"12.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 53.0mm | Inner Bore: 15.9mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 53.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 15.9"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 1.5"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0265, 0, 0.16, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.0265, 0, 0.16, 0.00795, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.00795, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: AL7075-T6 | Outer Dia: 80.0mm | Inner Bore: 24.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 80.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 24.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 8.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.04, 0, 0.16, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.04, 0, 0.16, 0.012, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.012, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "AL7075-T6"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: CuC360 | Outer Dia: 180.0mm | Inner Bore: 54.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 180.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 54.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 60.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 1.5"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.06, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.09, 0, 0.06, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.09, 0, 0.06, 0.027, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.027, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "CuC360"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Ti-6Al-4V | Outer Dia: 53.0mm | Inner Bore: 15.9mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 53.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 15.9"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 60.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 4.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.06, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0265, 0, 0.06, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.0265, 0, 0.06, 0.00795, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.00795, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Ti-6Al-4V"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 180.0mm | ID: 54.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 180.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 54.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 40.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 6.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"40.0",
        f"180.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"54.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 13.33
    for i in range(1, 3):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"168.0",
            f"12.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 35.0mm | Inner Bore: 10.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 35.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 10.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 45.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.045, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0175, 0, 0.045, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.045, 0.0175, 0, 0.045, 0.00525, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.045, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.00525, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Inconel718 | Outer Dia: 35.0mm | Inner Bore: 10.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 35.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 10.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 85.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 5.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.085, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0175, 0, 0.085, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.0175, 0, 0.085, 0.00525, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.00525, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Inconel718"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: AL7075-T6 | Outer Dia: 80.0mm | Inner Bore: 24.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 80.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 24.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 30.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 2.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.04, 0, 0.03, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.04, 0, 0.03, 0.012, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.012, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "AL7075-T6"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: CuC360 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 15.9mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 15.9"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 120.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 4.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.12, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.024, 0, 0.12, 0.00795, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.00795, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "CuC360"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: AL7075-T6 | Outer Dia: 35.0mm | Inner Bore: 10.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 35.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 10.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 30.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 2.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0175, 0, 0.03, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.0175, 0, 0.03, 0.00525, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.00525, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "AL7075-T6"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 110.0mm | Inner Bore: 33.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 110.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 33.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 40.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.04, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0165, 0, 0, 0.055, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.055, 0, 0.04, 0.055, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.055, 0, 0.04, 0.0165, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.0165, 0, 0, 0.0165, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

O2026 (WHEEL MOLD PARAMETRIC MACRO B - CIMCO VERIFIED)
(MATERIAL: Cr12MoV | ENVELOPE: D140.0 X L40.0)

(--- USER PARAMETRIC VARIABLES ---)

#102 = 140.00     (MAX FLANGE OUTER DIAMETER)
#103 = 53.00      (SHAFT BORE DIAMETER)
#104 = 3.00         (GROOVE BOTTOM RADIUS)
#105 = 15.00           (GROOVE 1 PROFILE RADIUS R1)
#106 = 12.00           (GROOVE 2 PROFILE RADIUS R2)
#107 = 10.00           (GROOVE 3 PROFILE RADIUS R3)

(--- INITIALIZATION & SAFE POSITION ---)
G21 G40 G97 G99
G28 U0.0 W0.0

N10 T0101 M03 S1200
G00 X[#102 + 4.0] Z2.0 M08
G71 U2.0 R0.8
G71 P100 Q110 U[#108] W0.1 F0.25
N100 G00 X[#103]
G01 Z0.0 F0.15
X[#102 - 1.0] C0.5
Z-[#101] F0.18
X[#102 + 2.0]
N110 G00 X[#102 + 4.0]

G70 P100 Q110 S1800 F0.12
G00 X[#102 + 10.0] Z50.0 M09
G28 U0.0 W0.0

(--- T0202: GROOVING ARCS R15 / R12 / R10 WITH G42 COMPENSATION ---)

G28 U0.0 W0.0
M30

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Steel45 | Outer Dia: 35.0mm | Inner Bore: 10.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub

messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 140.0mm | ID: 42.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 140.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 42.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 85.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 8.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"85.0",
        f"140.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"90.0",
        f"42.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 14.17
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"124.0",
            f"16.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Inconel718 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 8.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.16, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.024, 0, 0.16, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Inconel718"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Steel45 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 60.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.06, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.06, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.024, 0, 0.06, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Steel45"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 35.0mm | ID: 10.5mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 10.5")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 30.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 1.5")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"30.0",
        f"35.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.0",
        f"10.5",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 5.00
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"32.0",
            f"3.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: sscnc.create_setup_guide
messages.content:
# 斯沃数控仿真软件 (SSCNC FANUC 0i-TF) 实操对刀手册

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹
- **机床型号**：选择【FANUC 0i-TF 卧式斜床身数控车床】。
- **毛坯设置**：
  - 材料选择：`SS304`
  - 毛坯规格：外径 $\varnothing 69.0\text{mm}$，总长 $50.0\text{mm}$
  - 卡盘装夹：选择【三爪自定心液压卡盘】，夹持长度 $20.0\text{mm}$，工件伸出端长度 $35.0\text{mm}$。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R8.0全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $8.0\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。
   - 操纵 T0101 刀具轻微试切工件右端面，切平后 **保持 Z 轴不动**。
   - 刀具退回 X 正方向，进入 CNC 系统面板：【OFFSET SETTING】 $\to$ 【坐标系 (WORK)】 $\to$ 光标移动至 `G54` 的 `Z` 坐标列。
   - 键入 `Z0.`，按下屏幕下方软键【测量 (MEASUR)】，系统自动计算并写入 Z 轴工件原点偏移量。
2. **X 轴对刀（设定工件回转中心为 X0.000）**：
   - 摇动手轮使刀具轻微外圆试切一段长度（约 5~10mm），切削完成后 **保持 X 轴绝对不动**。
   - 沿 Z 轴正方向退出刀具，停止主轴。
   - 使用游标卡尺测量试切外圆实际直径 $D_{meas}$。
   - 进入 `G54` 的 `X` 坐标列，输入 `X[实际测量值]`，按下【测量 (MEASUR)】软键完成标定。

## 4. 仿真运行验证
- 调入宏程序 `O2026.NC`，闭合防护门，切入【自动加工 (AUTO)】模式，单段试切无过切后按下【循环启动 (CYCLE START)】。

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 65.0mm | Inner Bore: 19.3mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 65.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 19.3"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 1.5"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00965, 0, 0, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0325, 0, 0.16, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.0325, 0, 0.16, 0.00965, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.00965, 0, 0, 0.00965, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 65.0mm | Inner Bore: 19.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 65.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 19.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 40.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 5.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.04, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0325, 0, 0.04, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.0325, 0, 0.04, 0.00975, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.00975, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 65.0mm | Inner Bore: 19.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 65.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 19.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 5.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0325, 0, 0.16, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.0325, 0, 0.16, 0.00975, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.00975, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Inconel718 | Outer Dia: 80.0mm | Inner Bore: 24.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 80.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 24.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 60.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.06, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.04, 0, 0.06, 0.04, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.04, 0, 0.06, 0.012, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.06, 0.012, 0, 0, 0.012, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Inconel718"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Steel45 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 40.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 6.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.04, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.04, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.024, 0, 0.04, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Steel45"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: SS304 | OD: 80.0mm | ID: 24.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 80.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 24.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 60.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"60.0",
        f"80.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"65.0",
        f"24.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 12.00
    for i in range(1, 5):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"74.0",
            f"6.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Ti-6Al-4V | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 85.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 1.5"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.085, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.085, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.024, 0, 0.085, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Ti-6Al-4V"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: CuC360 | Outer Dia: 180.0mm | Inner Bore: 54.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 180.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 54.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 30.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.09, 0, 0.03, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.09, 0, 0.03, 0.027, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.027, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "CuC360"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Inconel718 | Outer Dia: 180.0mm | Inner Bore: 54.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 180.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 54.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 40.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 4.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.04, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.09, 0, 0.04, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.09, 0, 0.04, 0.027, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.027, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Inconel718"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: CuC360 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 120.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 3.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.12, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.024, 0, 0.12, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "CuC360"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Steel45 | Outer Dia: 65.0mm | Inner Bore: 19.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 65.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 19.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 120.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 4.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.12, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0325, 0, 0.12, 0.0325, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.0325, 0, 0.12, 0.00975, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.12, 0.00975, 0, 0, 0.00975, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Steel45"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: P20 | Outer Dia: 48.0mm | Inner Bore: 14.4mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 48.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 14.4"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 40.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 4.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.04, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.024, 0, 0.04, 0.024, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.024, 0, 0.04, 0.0072, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.04, 0.0072, 0, 0, 0.0072, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "P20"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 35.0mm | ID: 10.5mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 35.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 10.5")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 30.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"30.0",
        f"35.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.0",
        f"10.5",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 3.33
    for i in range(1, 9):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"29.0",
            f"6.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical

    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 65.0"

    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 45.0"

    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane

    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0325, 0, 0.045, 0.0325, 0

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Ti-6Al-4V | OD: 180.0mm | ID: 54.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 180.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 54.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 45.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 3.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"180.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"54.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 9.00
    for i in range(1, 5):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"174.0",
            f"6.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: Cr12MoV | OD: 140.0mm | ID: 42.0mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 140.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 42.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 30.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 5.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"30.0",
        f"140.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"35.0",
        f"42.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 5.00
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"130.0",
            f"10.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Steel45 | Outer Dia: 53.0mm | Inner Bore: 15.9mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 53.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 15.9"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 85.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 5.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.085, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0265, 0, 0.085, 0.0265, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.0265, 0, 0.085, 0.00795, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.085, 0.00795, 0, 0, 0.00795, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Steel45"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: Cr12MoV | Outer Dia: 35.0mm | Inner Bore: 10.5mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 35.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 10.5"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 30.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 2.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.0175, 0, 0.03, 0.0175, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.0175, 0, 0.03, 0.00525, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.03, 0.00525, 0, 0, 0.00525, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "Cr12MoV"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub

messages.name: nx.create_nxopen_script
messages.content:
# =========================================================================
# Siemens NX 12.0 Python Open API Parametric Journal
# Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
# Material: SS304 | OD: 53.0mm | ID: 15.9mm
# =========================================================================

import NXOpen
import NXOpen.UF
import math

def main():
    the_session = NXOpen.Session.GetSession()
    the_uf_session = NXOpen.UF.UFSession.GetUFSession()
    work_part = the_session.Parts.Work

    # 1. Define Parametric Expressions in Expression Manager
    exp_mgr = work_part.Expressions
    mm = work_part.UnitCollection.FindObject("MilliMeter")
    
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_OUTER", f"[{mm.FullName}] 53.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("D_BORE", f"[{mm.FullName}] 15.9")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("TOTAL_LENGTH", f"[{mm.FullName}] 45.0")
    exp_mgr.CreateWithUnits("GROOVE_R", f"[{mm.FullName}] 5.0")

    # 2. Create Outer Cylinder Stock
    # CreateCyl1(FeatureSign, Origin[3], Height, Diameter, Direction[3])
    cyl_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Nullsign,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"45.0",
        f"53.0",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 3. Create Inner Bore Cylinder (Boolean Subtraction)
    bore_tag = the_uf_session.Modl.CreateCyl1(
        NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        f"50.0",
        f"15.9",
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    )

    # 4. Create Multi-Step Radial Grooves (Torus Boolean Subtractions)
    pitch = 7.50
    for i in range(1, 6):
        z_pos = -pitch * i
        # CreateTorus(FeatureSign, Center[3], RingDia, TubeDia, Direction[3])
        the_uf_session.Modl.CreateTorus(
            NXOpen.UF.UFModl.FeatureSigns.Negative,
            [0.0, 0.0, z_pos],
            f"43.0",
            f"10.0",
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        )

    # 5. Update and Save Work Part
    the_uf_session.Modl.Update()
    print("[SUCCESS] Siemens NX 12.0 Parametric Model & Features Built.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

messages.name: solidworks.create_parametric_part
messages.content:
' =========================================================================
' SOLIDWORKS 2021 VBA Parametric Driver Macro
' Intent: Parametric Generation of Engineered Workpiece
' Material: CuC360 | Outer Dia: 180.0mm | Inner Bore: 54.0mm
' =========================================================================

Dim swApp As SldWorks.SldWorks
Dim Part As SldWorks.ModelDoc2
Dim swEqnMgr As SldWorks.EquationMgr
Dim boolstatus As Boolean
Dim longstatus As Long

Sub Main()
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument("C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS 2021\templates\Part.prtdot", 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Failed to create part. Please check template path.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 1. Set Global Variables in Equation Manager
    Set swEqnMgr = Part.GetEquationMgr
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 0, ""D_Outer" = 180.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 1, ""D_Bore" = 54.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 2, ""Length" = 160.0"
    swEqnMgr.AddEquation 3, ""R_GrooveArc" = 8.0"
    
    ' 2. Create Revolve Base Sketch on Front Plane
    boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Front Plane", "PLANE", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
    Part.SketchManager.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    
    ' Centerline on Spindle Axis
    Part.SketchManager.CreateCenterLine 0, 0, 0, 0.16, 0, 0
    ' Outer boundary profile
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0, 0.09, 0, 0.16, 0.09, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.09, 0, 0.16, 0.027, 0
    Part.SketchManager.CreateLine 0.16, 0.027, 0, 0, 0.027, 0
    
    ' 3. Revolve Feature (360 deg)
    Dim swFeature As SldWorks.Feature
    Set swFeature = Part.FeatureManager.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0, 6.2831853, 0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
    
    ' 4. Add Material & Simulation Setup
    Part.SetMaterialPropertyName2 "Default", "SOLIDWORKS Materials", "CuC360"
    Part.ViewZoomtofit2
    Part.EditRebuild3
    MsgBox "SOLIDWORKS 2021 Parametric Model Successfully Generated!", vbInformation
End Sub
